description: This file contains pytest tests for a FastAPI application, including fixtures to instantiate the test client with different Python version modules, and test functions to validate API responses and the generated OpenAPI schema.

classes.name: TestClient
classes.description: FastAPI's test client used to simulate HTTP requests to the API application for testing purposes.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on the request param and returns a TestClient instance for testing the FastAPI app.

methods.name: test_post_body_example(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests a PUT request to update an item and asserts a successful response with status code 200.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenAPI schema from the app and asserts it matches the expected specification.
